title: Dye Recipe Tweaks
description: Modifies dyed item recipes from mods to be more consistent with vanilla crafting.
body:
Fixes many dye recipes in some mods and vanilla which either don't have proper crafting, or use tags. Now you can craft a blue candle from a red candle and blue dye, or you can craft a green chair from "Another Furniture" from a blue chair and green dye!

### **Please look at the images in the gallery to see how they've changed**. 

Let me know on discord if there are any mods you would like to see supported! You can also submit mod requests as an issue on the github page! 

**_I will not add support for mods that add more dyes to the game. This includes "Dye Depot", and "L and El's Dye Mod."_**

@willowisp2002

Supported Mods:
- [Another Furniture](https://modrinth.com/mod/another-furniture)
- [Farmer's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight) [(including the Fabric port.)](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight-refabricated)

Planned Mods:
- [Supplementaries](https://modrinth.com/mod/supplementaries)
